description: Maintainer-workflow triage over a running kenn-forge daemon — PR/issue review, diffs and CI checks, local review state, and coding-agent handoff. Two surfaces over the same daemon API: the kenn_forge_* MCP tools for an agent driving its own loop, and the kenn-forge CLI for shell, scripts, and humans. The daemon must be running locally; the MCP surface additionally needs it enabled in the daemon config. Release history: https://github.com/hsb3/dotfiles-agents/releases.
name: kenn-forge
